MATCH (start:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id, acct_no: $a})
// first hop
MATCH (start)-[:TRANSFER]->(a1:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH start, collect(DISTINCT a1) AS first_hop
// second hop
UNWIND first_hop AS node1
MATCH (node1)-[:TRANSFER]->(a2:Account {_workspace_id: $workspace_id})
WITH first_hop, collect(DISTINCT a2) AS second_hop
// combine distinct reachable accounts (exclude start)
UNWIND first_hop + second_hop AS reach
WITH DISTINCT reach
RETURN count(reach) AS reachable_count, max(reach.risk_tier) AS max_risk_tier
LIMIT $limit
